label: The information contest
text: ST.O.A5.5 — All warfare is based on deception [suntzu-c02]; the artifice of deviation [suntzu-c08]. Spies and foreknowledge [suntzu-c13]; reading signs [suntzu-c10]. Active measures: definition, misconceptions, craft, epistemic erosion, asymmetry, digital acceleration, attribution [rid-c01]–[rid-c07]. Home-field advantage, NOBUS, fourth-party collection [buchanan-c03], [buchanan-c04], [buchanan-c05]. Hiding loose slot machines [aos-c13]. AI-enabled deception and decision support (no card yet).

warrant.standard: Attribution and effect established from dated records [rid-c07].
warrant.defeaters: Covert record; contested attribution; unmeasurable effect.
